fixes.title: Pastes containing a web image no longer insert nothing
fixes.problem: Pasting a web article, or rich text editor content with an already-uploaded image, inserted nothing at all. The text, links, lists, tables and the image were all silently lost.
fixes.cause: The `summernote.paste` handler returned early whenever `/]+src=["']https?:\/\//i` matched the clipboard HTML. It assumed `onImageUpload` would deal with the image, but that callback only fires for image files, never for `` tags in HTML. `e.preventDefault()` had already run, so nothing was inserted.
fixes.change: The early return is removed. Clipboard HTML with http(s) images now goes through `buildInsertNodes` and `cleanHtml`, which keep loadable http(s) and `data:` images and insert the surrounding content as normal.

mixed-content pastes › multiple tables and images in one paste: all retained in document order
fixes.shot: web page paste › article containing an https image pastes fully — text, link and image

fixes.title: Pastes with embedded base64 images now save to Appian
fixes.problem: Content pasted from modern Word, or from another editor, with images embedded inside the HTML looked correct but never saved to Appian. Saving hung waiting forever.
fixes.cause: Images embedded as `data:` URIs in clipboard HTML had no upload path: `onImageUpload` only fires for image files. `setAppianValue` refuses to save while base64 content exists, so the save never went through.
fixes.change: After inserting, the paste handler scans `.note-editable` for images where `isImageNewBase64` is true. For each one it follows the same flow as `onImageUpload`: add the `loading` class, call `uploadBase64Img`, swap in the returned document URL, remove `loading`, then call `setAppianValue`. Images that are already uploading are skipped by `isImageNewBase64`.

fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › Word section with text, embedded image, list and table SAVES to Appian

fixes.title: Multi-line plain text keeps its line breaks when pasted
fixes.problem: Pasting multi-line plain text, for example from Notepad, a terminal or a PDF viewer, ran all the lines together into one line. Text after the caret could end up in the wrong place.
fixes.cause:
Plain-text clipboard content went straight to `DOMParser` and was inserted as a single text node, so its newlines collapsed into nothing when rendered. Upstream never ran it through the raw-text branch of `cleanHtml`, which is the code that turns newlines into `
`.
fixes.change:
When the clipboard content does not start with `<`, the handler now runs `cleanHtml(clipboardHtml, true)`, which turns newlines into `
`. If the result contains a `
`, it is wrapped in one `

` so `insertNode` inserts it in a single step. Inserting bare text and `
` pieces one at a time misplaces the caret and loses later lines. Single-line text stays unwrapped and is still inserted inline.

RTE to RTE copy/paste › plain-text paste converts newlines to line breaks
PDF paste › multi-paragraph text: all paragraphs retained with line breaks
PDF paste › bulleted list: bullet glyphs and every item retained on separate lines
fixes.shot: paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text: spacing correct AND caret ends at the end of the pasted text

fixes.title: Source-code newlines in pasted HTML no longer become line breaks
fixes.problem: Pasting from Word or web pages broke sentences across lines wherever the source HTML happened to wrap. A Word Shift+Enter hard return turned into a double line break. Spaces between neighbouring formatted words could also disappear.
fixes.cause:
In `cleanHtml`'s branch for pasted HTML, only ` ` became a space. Any remaining ` ` in text was turned into `
` (`.replace(/ /g, "
")`), and `.replace(/>\s+<")` removed real spaces between inline tags. The paste handler also dropped every whitespace-only top-level text node. The Word list cleanup removed only ` ? `, so a lone ` ` was missed.
fixes.change: `cleanHtml` now turns every CR/LF in pasted HTML into a space and no longer strips whitespace between tags. `buildInsertNodes` keeps whitespace text nodes between inline nodes, but drops them when they sit next to a block element (`isBlockElement`), because inserting them there stops `insertNode` from inserting the later blocks. The Word list regex now removes `[\r\n]+`.

MS Word paste › hard returns (Shift+Enter) become a single
, not extra paragraphs
fixes.shot: MS Word paste › REGRESSION (original reported bug): source newlines between inline spans stay one sentence

fixes.title: Code blocks keep every line when pasted
fixes.problem: Pasting a code block from a web page kept only its first line. Everything after it was lost.
fixes.cause:
`
` is not an allowed tag. After `cleanHtml` converted its newlines and stripped the tag, what remained was a bare run of text and `
` at the top level, which stops Summernote's `insertNode` from inserting the remaining lines.
fixes.change:
`cleanHtml` now finds `
` blocks first, turns their newlines into `
` and wraps each block in `
`, so the lines are inserted together as one paragraph. This happens before all other newlines are turned into spaces.

fixes.title: Images no longer paste twice when the clipboard carries a file
fixes.problem: Copying an image from a PDF viewer or a web page pasted it twice. Excel or Word range copies added a picture of the table next to the table. Outlook copies produced a duplicate or broken image.
fixes.cause: Summernote's built-in clipboard image pasting (`allowClipboardImagePasting` default) always inserted clipboard image files through `onImageUpload`. The paste handler also inserted the HTML version, which already contained the image or the table. Outlook's `cid:` `` was also kept by `cleanHtml`.
fixes.change: `allowClipboardImagePasting: false` is set in `buildEditor`, so the paste handler alone decides about clipboard files. If the HTML has no visible text, it inserts the files with `insertImagesOrCallback` and returns. If the HTML references an unloadable image (`UNLOADABLE_IMG_REGEX`, e.g. `cid:`), it inserts the file and continues with the text. Otherwise the file is treated as a duplicate and ignored.

fixes.title: Broken file and relative image references are no longer pasted
fixes.problem: Images pasted from Word or Excel came in as references to temporary files on the copier's machine, and relative-URL images came in too. They were saved to Appian as permanently broken images.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` kept any `` once images were allowed, whatever its `src`: `file:///` clip_image paths, `cid:`, relative URLs or no `src` at all. Its attribute regex also skipped empty or unquoted attributes, such as Word's `v:=""`.
fixes.change: `cleanHtml` has a new Step 6.5 that runs only for pasted content (`isPartialHtml`). It removes `` tags whose `src` is not `http(s):` or `data:`, and keeps the surrounding text. Stored content, including relative document URLs, is left alone.

fixes.title: Pasted script and style contents no longer leak in as text
fixes.problem: Pasting HTML with a `<script>` or `<style>` block inserted the code as visible text. Content after the script could also be lost.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` Step 2 removed only disallowed tags and kept their contents, so `<script>alert(1)</script>` became `alert(1)`.
fixes.change: `cleanHtml` has a new Step 0 that removes `script`, `style`, `iframe`, `object`, `embed` and `noscript` together with their contents (`DANGEROUS_TAGS_PATTERN`). It also removes lone opening or self-closing forms of those tags (`DANGEROUS_TAGS_SELF_CLOSING_PATTERN`).

fixes.shot: paste sanitization › script tags are removed with their contents and never execute

fixes.title: Inline content after a pasted table no longer lands inside it
fixes.problem: When a paste contained a table followed by inline content, such as an image or text, that content ended up inside the table's last cell. The pasted content came out of order.
fixes.cause: `insertNode` leaves the caret inside a newly inserted table's last cell. A range set just after the table is pulled back into that cell, and `insertNode` reads Summernote's stored `lastRange`, not the live selection.
fixes.change: In the insert loop, when a table is followed by an inline node, the handler reuses an empty paragraph after the table or creates one. It puts the selection inside that paragraph and calls `editor.setLastRange` before inserting the next node.

fixes.title: Screenshot paste now respects the allowImages setting
fixes.problem: When images were disabled, pasting a screenshot still inserted and uploaded the image.
fixes.cause: `allowImages` only controlled the toolbar picture button and HTML cleaning. Image files on the clipboard still reached `onImageUpload`, which never checked the setting.
fixes.change: `onImageUpload` now returns straight away when `window.allowImages` is false, so every way of adding an image respects the setting.

fixes.shot: image manipulation › screenshot paste is blocked when allowImages is false

fixes.title: No stray blank lines left behind after pasting
fixes.problem: Pressing Enter and then pasting left an extra empty line at the paste point. Pasting repeatedly piled up empty paragraphs at the bottom of the editor.
fixes.cause:
Upstream did no cleanup after pasting. The empty `


` Summernote leaves at the caret, and new empty paragraphs at the end of the editor, stayed in place.
fixes.change:
Before inserting, the handler records the empty caret paragraph (`findCaretEmptyParagraph`) and the empty paragraphs already at the end of the editor (`snapshotTrailingEmptyParagraphs`). Afterwards `removePasteArtifacts` removes the caret paragraph if it is still empty, including a bare `

`. It then removes new empty paragraphs from the end, keeping the ones that were there before the paste.

paste empty-paragraph cleanup › repeated pastes do not accumulate trailing empty paragraphs
fixes.shot: paste empty-paragraph cleanup › repeated pastes do not accumulate trailing empty paragraphs

fixes.title: Caret sits below a pasted table with one blank line
fixes.problem: After pasting a table, the caret appeared stuck on the table's header until the user typed. A table pasted into the middle of text left two blank lines before the following text.
fixes.cause:
The upstream trailing-table block always inserted a new `


` with `editor.insertNode`, even when splitting the paragraph had already left an empty one after the table. It also left the selection after that paragraph's `
`, where browsers draw the caret against the table's edge.
fixes.change:
The paste handler now reuses `lastNode.nextSibling` when `isEmptyParagraph` is true, and only creates a paragraph otherwise. It then collapses the selection to offset 0 of that paragraph, before the `
`.

fixes.title: Content-too-big error no longer flashes during image uploads
fixes.problem: The maximum-size validation error appeared briefly every time an image was uploading, then disappeared.
fixes.cause: `validate` compared `getEditorContents().length` against `maxSize`, which counted the image's large temporary base64 `data:` URI. That data is never actually saved.
fixes.change: `validate` replaces `src="data:..."` and `src='data:...'` with `src=""` before measuring, so the size matches what would be saved. The `getEditorContents` call stays behind the `!isReadOnly()` check.
tests: editor lifecycle › maxSize validation does not flash while an image uploads
fixes.shot: editor lifecycle › maxSize validation does not flash while an image uploads

fixes.title: Modern strikethrough from web pages is kept
fixes.problem: Strikethrough text copied from web pages or from editor content using `<s>` lost its formatting when pasted.
fixes.cause: `ALLOWED_TAGS` included `strike` but not `s`, so `cleanHtml` stripped `<s>` tags.

fixes.title: Unquoted and single-quoted attributes now go through the allowlist
fixes.problem: Attributes that were unquoted, single-quoted or empty (Word emits ones like `border=1` and `v:=""`) skipped the attribute allowlist and stayed in the cleaned HTML.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` Step 3 matched only double-quoted, non-empty values (`([\w-]+)="[^"]+?"`). The Step 4 style regex lookahead accepted only `"`.
fixes.change: Step 3 now matches double-quoted, single-quoted and unquoted values, including empty ones (`([\w-]+)=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)`). The Step 4 lookahead accepts either quote type.
code: cleanHtml (Step 3 attribute allowlist, Step 4 style filter)

fixes.title: Multi-line HTML comments are fully removed
fixes.problem: HTML comments that span several lines, such as Word's conditional comments, could survive cleaning and leak into the content.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` Step 7 used `/<!--.*?-->/g`, and `.` does not match newlines.
fixes.change: Step 7 now uses `/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g`, which matches across lines.

otherChanges: Refactored the inline paste handler into the named helpers `buildInsertNodes`, `isBlockElement`, `hasBlankText`, `isEmptyParagraph`, `findCaretEmptyParagraph`, `snapshotTrailingEmptyParagraphs` and `removePasteArtifacts`, using `parentNode.removeChild` for IE compatibility.
Moved `BLOCK_LEVEL_REGEX` and the dangerous-tag regexes up to module constants so they are not rebuilt on every call.
Ran Prettier and rewrote the paste-handling and `cleanHtml` comments.

Updated existing `cleanHtml` unit tests for the new behaviour: newlines become spaces, script and style contents are stripped, `<s>` is allowed, and the expected output for the attribute-with-`>` edge case changed.
Added unit test files `cleanHtml.imageSources.test.js` and `pastePlainTextLineBreaks.test.js`, and rewrote the `pasteHandling.test.js` image-skip test.
